info.name: brite-sms
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for the Brite SMS NestJS API. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:3000/api/v1 via {{baseUrl}}. Protected endpoints inherit Bearer {{accessToken}} from the collection; run Auth / Login first to populate the token.

request.description:
Authenticate with email or phone and password. Saves the returned access token to the active Postman environment.

Auth: Public endpoint. No bearer token required.
Request body: JSON matching the included example body.

Successful responses use { success: true, message, data }. Paginated list responses use data.items and data.pagination. Error responses use { success: false, statusCode, message, path, timestamp } and may include errors for validation failures.
